tools.name: check_citation
tools.description: Check one US legal citation, or a sentence holding a few: whether it exists in the sources Loupe checks, which case it is, and whether a pin cite falls inside the opinion. Give it exactly as written, with the case name and year if the document has them, because the commonest error is a real citation

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search the case names in Loupe's index, or look up the case a citation names. Give the parties' names, and the year if known. A case missing from the results may still exist.
